title: "Canonical design API"
subtitle: "Shared configuration, reusable factories, one-draw functions, and outcome components"
---

```{python}
import inspect

import pandas as pd
import pypanelsim as pps
```

## `CanonicalPanelConfig`

```{python}
print(f"CanonicalPanelConfig{inspect.signature(pps.CanonicalPanelConfig)}")
```

| Field | Default | Contract |
|---|---:|---|
| `n_control` | `160` | Positive never-treated count |
| `n_treated` | `40` | Positive treated count |
| `n_pre` | `40` | Positive common pre-period count |
| `n_post` | `10` | Positive post-period count |
| `effect_slope` | `0.2` | Finite event-time slope |
| `noise_variance` | `0.36` | Finite nonnegative observation-noise variance |

Properties `n_units`, `n_periods`, and `dimensions` derive the generic panel
shape. Canonical factories put controls first, treated units last, and begin
treatment at `n_pre`.

## Reusable design factories

Each factory returns a configured `PanelSimulator` and accepts
`config=CanonicalPanelConfig(...)` for dimension changes.

```{python}
factories = [
    pps.classic_factor_design,
    pps.weak_factor_design,
    pps.synthetic_control_design,
    pps.factor_synthetic_design,
    pps.time_series_design,
    pps.mixed_factor_design,
]
pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "factory": [function.__name__ for function in factories],
        "signature": [str(inspect.signature(function)) for function in factories],
    }
)
```

| Factory | Untreated-outcome law | Main parameter validation |
|---|---|---|
| `classic_factor_design` | Two standardized drifting factors | `overlap >= 0` |
| `weak_factor_design` | Five weak drift and five weak cyclical factors | `overlap >= 0` |
| `synthetic_control_design` | Sparse convex donor signal | `0 < active_share <= 1` |
| `factor_synthetic_design` | Equal factor/donor mixture | `overlap >= 0` |
| `time_series_design` | Unit AR(1) or integrated AR(1) paths | `abs(coefficient) < 1` |
| `mixed_factor_design` | Drift half-panel plus cyclical half-panel | `overlap >= 0`; treated count below half of units |

See [canonical design laws](../canonical-designs.md) for draw order and exact
probability specifications.

## One-draw functions

The one-draw functions construct the corresponding simulator and call
`simulate(seed=..., rng=...)`.

```{python}
draw_functions = [
    pps.classic_factor,
    pps.weak_factor,
    pps.synthetic_control,
    pps.factor_synthetic,
    pps.time_series,
    pps.mixed_factor,
]
pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "function": [function.__name__ for function in draw_functions],
        "signature": [str(inspect.signature(function)) for function in draw_functions],
    }
)
```

Passing both `seed` and `rng` raises `ValueError`. A fixed seed preserves the
extracted canonical NumPy draw order for a fixed compatible NumPy version.

## Canonical outcome components

These classes can also be composed outside the canonical factories:

```{python}
outcome_components = [
    pps.ClassicFactorOutcome,
    pps.WeakFactorOutcome,
    pps.SyntheticControlOutcome,
    pps.FactorSyntheticOutcome,
    pps.TimeSeriesOutcome,
    pps.MixedFactorOutcome,
]
pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "component": [component.__name__ for component in outcome_components],
        "signature": [str(inspect.signature(component)) for component in outcome_components],
    }
)
```

All implement `generate(context, rng) -> ComponentDraw`. Factor components store
unit-aligned loadings and factor paths in metadata. Synthetic designs add active
donors and donor weights. Time-series designs store the latent process before
observation noise. Metadata arrays are diagnostic truth and become read-only in
the final dataset.

## Named construction

```{python}
print(f"make_canonical{inspect.signature(pps.make_canonical)}")
print(f"available_canonical_designs{inspect.signature(pps.available_canonical_designs)}")
print(pps.available_canonical_designs())
```

`make_canonical(name, **kwargs)` delegates to the global canonical registry.
Unknown names and invalid factory parameters raise `ValueError`/`TypeError` from
the registry or selected factory.

## Compatibility aliases

`PanelConfig` aliases `CanonicalPanelConfig`; `PanelData` aliases
`PanelDataset`. They remain for migration from the extracted `panel_dgps`
module. New code should use the explicit canonical and dataset names.
